description: ItemsAdder behaviours.block.placed_model.type -> CraftEngine state.auto_state group. CraftEngine registers real blocks the same way ItemsAdder does (note block / mushroom / chorus / tripwire carriers), so the carrier families line up almost exactly.

REAL_NOTE.note: ItemsAdder REAL_NOTE (note_block carrier, ~750 blocks) maps to CraftEngine auto_state: note_block.

REAL.note: ItemsAdder REAL (mushroom carrier, ~191 blocks) maps to CraftEngine auto_state: mushroom_stem.

REAL_TRANSPARENT.note: ItemsAdder REAL_TRANSPARENT (chorus carrier, ~63 blocks) maps to CraftEngine auto_state: chorus with transparent: true.

REAL_WIRE.note: ItemsAdder REAL_WIRE (tripwire carrier, ~127 blocks) maps to CraftEngine auto_state: tripwire. shift_up tall-plant variants need multi_high_block.

TILE.note: ItemsAdder TILE is a retextured spawner with no per-texture limit. CraftEngine has no unlimited-id carrier: the block is generated on a solid carrier, so it consumes a real block id. Review capacity before enabling large TILE sets.

FIRE.note: ItemsAdder FIRE blocks (custom fire) have no CraftEngine equivalent.
